MikroTik hEX E50UG Ethernet Router – High Performance, Secure Wired Networking for Home & Business

The MikroTik hEX E50UG is a compact yet powerful Ethernet router designed for environments that require a reliable and secure wired network. With five Gigabit Ethernet ports and a high-speed USB 2.0 port, this device delivers exceptional routing performance and advanced security features. Whether you're managing a small office network or upgrading your home internet setup, the hEX E50UG is an ideal choice for efficient and budget-friendly networking.


Key Features:

  • Powerful Dual-Core CPU – Ensures fast data processing and efficient routing performance.
  • 5 x Gigabit Ethernet Ports – Seamlessly connect multiple devices with high-speed wired connections.
  • USB 2.0 Port – Connect 4G/LTE modems or external storage for advanced applications.
  • RouterOS with License Level 4 – Access advanced features including firewall, VPN, bandwidth control, hotspot, and more.
  • Compact & Durable Design – Ideal for desktop setups with efficient heat dissipation.
  • Secure & Stable Networking – Includes advanced firewall options and encrypted VPN support.
  • Affordable for SOHO/ISP Use – Perfect for ISPs, SMBs, and home offices needing secure and fast internet routing.
